SECRET

P.F.46464/S.L.(A) 1.
G.St.C.P/EFSB

28th March 1942.

Your ref. JS/KV/3085

Dear Commander Senter,

Stanislas REZLAW alias GROEHL.

I return herewith your papers concerning the above man.

Yours sincerely,

[signature]

For G.St.C.Pilcher.

Lt. Commander John Senter,
R.N.V.R.,
S.O.E.
